lines: ――There was an organization known as the “DSO”.
Its official title was the Defense Sciences Office.

It was an organization established at the behest of the UFS Department of Defense (which was committed to opposing Nomad and Demon World technology), and composed of personnel with special technical skills and
fighting abilities.
At present, the influence of “demons” on the human world was being kept to a minimum, thanks to their classified activities――
――Nighttime.
A southern tropical resort area.
On an islet off the coast of there was the figure of a woman, who had come ashore in a swimwear-style Taimanin suit.
Masked Taimanin
「......I've arrived on the island. Stand by over there until the appointed time.」
The masked woman whispered, into a communications device that was fitted to her earring.
This little island was a secret social venue for those in the know.
VIPs from around the globe who were involved in the criminal underworld came here to satisfy their own selfish desires.
Naturally, security was tight, and it was difficult to enter the island directly.
As such, the masked woman had approached on a tiny boat until she was just outside spotter range, and then dived into the sea to make her way to the island unchallenged.
Guard 1
「Anything unusual?」
Guard 2
「Nope. No problems.」
Masked Taimanin
Guards passed by the patch of thick grass where the masked woman was hiding.
Even for this island, where security was tight already, there were an especial lot of watchful eyes in this part of it.
Masked Taimanin
（As I thought...... Looks like it's up ahead, hmm......?）
Masked Taimanin
Masked Taimanin
（A dangerous enhanced human, crossed between the cells of Igawa Asagi and Edwin Black......）
That was the woman's mission on this occasion.
What lay ahead was an illegal auction house operated by the Nomad crime syndicate.
There, they dealt in all manner of “merchandise” (primarily involving Demon World technology) for the benefit of the VIP guests who visited from around the globe. However......
What was serving as this auction's centrepiece was “Ba Chou”, an enhanced human prototype.
Masked Taimanin
（Those guys from Ryuumon...... They sure left something dangerous behind.）
Ba Chou had been created in a research facility owned by “Ryuumon” (Dragon Gate), a Chinese Union-affiliated organization in Tokyo Kingdom.

It was an extremely dangerous monster, based on a cloned body of Igawa Asagi and compounded with the cells of Edwin Black, possessing simultaneously both the strength of the Almighty Taimanin and the demonic power
of the King of the Undead.
That thing had been hidden deep within its research facility, as even the Ryuumon scientists who had developed it were unable to fully control it, but――
It had been released by Nisha Gaiza of all people, the head of the fledgling Fuuma Ninja Forces, which had broken away from Gosha.
To raise capital, he had sold off Ba Chou, which they had discovered in the research facility when they drove Ryuumon to annihilation during a power struggle in Tokyo Kingdom.
Masked Taimanin
（Honestly...... I wonder if I'll need to punish that Fuuma boy now, too?）
The masked woman, who had concealed herself in the darkness, breathed an exasperated sigh.
The mission of the “DSO”, which the woman belonged to, was to curb the spread and misuse of Hellish technology.
There was no way that they could allow a dangerous being like Ba Chou to be let loose.
Seize or destroy――The woman had come to this southern island to carry out either one of those things.
Masked Taimanin
（......I can't afford to dawdle, can I?）
The time was approaching for the appointment with her “collaborator”, who had gone undercover here already.
After waiting for the guards to pass by, the woman began to quietly proceed through the darkness.
Masked Taimanin
Masked Taimanin
（So this is the hotel in question......）
There was an extravagant members-only hotel where VIPs gathered from around the world.
The auction of Ba Chou was to take place in a few days, in the auction house adjoining it.
Masked Taimanin
（Now, I wonder how “her” work is going......?）
Music and the voices of people partying were audible from the building.
At first glance, it looked to be a calm and peaceful scene, but, however――
The area around the hotel was stringently guarded by a state-of-the-art security system that had been set up.
In the unlikely event that the “collaborator” who had gone undercover before her had failed to disarm that, carrying out the mission would be hopeless, but......
Masked Taimanin
Stealthily penetrating the grounds, the woman relaxed her lips into a smile.
The security was disabled.
It was just as planned.
Her collaborator appeared to have done well.
All the way around the back of the building was the warehouse that served as the rendezvous point with that “collaborator”.
Makishima Ayame
「―――There you are, Client-san. All is prepared.」
Masked Taimanin
「I'd expect no less, Ayame. You do good work, as always.」
Waiting by herself in the deserted warehouse was a woman wearing an alluring party outfit.
It was her “collaborator”, Makishima Ayame.
Ayame
「Well, naturally. You are one of our few “regulars”, so I have to work hard for you♪」
Masked Taimanin
「Your assistance has always been a great help. Yours, and your master's.」
The masked woman smiled and bowed her head.
Ayame and her master―Shinganji Kurenai―were former Fuuma Taimanin.
However, they had left the main Gosha Taimanin forces to conduct their own independent activities, and had, at times, even taken on jobs from the masked woman, as mercenaries.
This mission was also one of those.
Ayame had gone ahead and infiltrated the island first, posing as the mistress of a VIP guest, and had been performing covert work such as disarming the security system.
Masked Taimanin
「I was concerned, since we did bring our plans forward. But you dealt with it splendidly.」
Originally, the seizure of Ba Chou had been scheduled to be carried out two days later.
However, owing to certain circumstances, they had brought that forward, and made it this very night.
Ayame
「Indeed. I was a bit surprised, for sure. It's rare for your meticulous self to change your plans at the last moment...... Did something happen?」
Masked Taimanin
「We got some information. New intelligence we couldn't overlook regarding that monster――Ba Chou.」
Ayame
「New intelligence?」
Masked Taimanin
「Yes. One of the Ryuumon scientists who created it confessed.」
Masked Taimanin
「There's a risk of it going on a rampage. It's being kept under control with drugs for now, but――apparently, there's not much time before the effects of them wear off.」
Ayame
「Oh, my?」
Probably because they had fused cells which harboured the immense power of Asagi and Black, they had never, right until the end, succeeded in controlling Ba Chou.
Not possessing a single shred of proper intelligence or rationality, it had carried out multiple rampages in a crazed search for blood.
The Ryuumon scientists, who had been at a loss for how to handle it, had been keeping Ba Chou in a dormant state by overdosing it on drugs, but――
Ayame
「All because that Nisha boy took it from where it belonged, you mean.」
Masked Taimanin
「Indeed. Quite the troublesome problem child.」
Ayame
「There are a lot of problem children when it comes to young Fuuma lords. Of completely different types, though.」
Masked Taimanin
「Fufu, for sure――」
The masked woman gave a wry laugh.
The Fuuma family, a prestigious Taimanin clan, was currently in the middle of a petty factional power struggle.
Nisha Gaiza, who was well-respected by his followers, and had led his forces to break off from Gosha.
On the other side, Fuuma Kotarou, heir to the head family, who, despite being a “diot” who couldn't use a Ninja Art, was achieving solid results by leading the Independent Commando Unit.
For the masked woman, both of those young men were intriguing targets for observation.
Ayame
「Well, as far as I'm concerned, I'd welcome being able to return to Japan even a day sooner. I'm worried about Kurenai-sama as well.」
Masked Taimanin
「Her? Is she taking on a difficult mission or something?」
While Shinganji Kurenai did possess unparalleled strength, on the other hand, delicate missions were not a strong point of hers.
Thus, on this occasion, Ayame (who excelled at undercover work) had come to this island on her own.
Ayame
「It's...... not a mission. It's about the young Fuuma lord I just mentioned.」
Masked Taimanin
Ayame
「Since reuniting with him for the first time in ages, Kurenai-sama has been strangely restless...... Haahhh...」
Ayame
「I'm worried...... Something funny might be going on while I'm not looking.」
Masked Taimanin
「Fufu, I see. Overprotective as ever, eh?♪」
Ayame was making an unusually sullen face. This female Taimanin was always composed, but there seemed to be an exception when it came to her young lord.
Masked Taimanin
「I know of a similar case, so I'm no stranger to this either.」
The woman smiled amusedly, and shot a glance over her own shoulder.
Ayame
「? Oh, by any chance, do you mean――」
Masked Taimanin
「Fufu, well, something like that♪ More importantly, let's make haste. You've already ascertained the route to the storage room, yes?」
Ayame
「Yes. This way.」
A passageway leading to the hotel's subterranean storage room――
Guard 1
「?! Who the hell are you――Ugh?!」
Guard 2
「Gah!!」
Dosaaah!
The collapsed guards' bodies were dragged into the darkness at the end of the corridor.
Ayame
Masked Taimanin
Having subdued the guards in an instant, Ayame and the masked woman nodded to each other in silence.
While carefully concealing themselves, the two of them pushed forward through the hotel basement quickly.
The section with the storage room they were heading for was now in front of their eyes.
But then――
Beeep, beeep, beeep!!
Masked Taimanin
Ayame
The pair's bodies stiffened due to the alarm that had suddenly sounded.
“Has our infiltration been detected?” they wondered for a moment, but there was no sign of reinforcements heading their way.
Given that, then...
Communications Device
『――R-Requesting backup, ASAP!!!』
Communications Device
『It's the monster!!! The monster's woken up in the storage room, and she's going berser――Uaaaahhhh!!!』
Desperate cries and screams from the communication devices which belonged to the guards they had incapacitated.
Following that, strange noises, like something squashing fresh meat――
Masked Taimanin
「......Sounds like we need to hurry, hmm?」
Ayame
It appeared that the situation they were fearing had occurred.
The two of them looked at each other and nodded, then dashed to the storeroom that was the epicentre of the commotion.
The underground storeroom for auction items.
In that room, where that noisy alarm rang, a pile of corpses had been formed by a fantastical monster.
「AAAAaaAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!」
Guard 5
「Guuuh...... I'll shoot you full of holes, you monster!! Die, diiiiiieeeee!!」
Gagagagagagagagagagagah!!!
Ayame
Following the sounds of gunfire that rang out, a wet popping noise, like something squashing fruit.
Fresh blood gushed out from all across the body of a guard, who had been wrapped around by its tentacles, and he was then tossed to the ground, reduced to pitiful chunks of meat.
Masked Taimanin
「The situation is...... more serious than we thought, I see.」
The masked woman whispered, hiding in the shadows near the entrance to the storage room.
This was “Ba Chou”.
An enhanced human created from the cells of Igawa Asagi and Edwin Black.
That monster had awoken from its drug-induced slumber, and begun a merciless massacre.
Ba Chou
「Aahhh...... AAaAAAAAAAAHHHH......!」
Guard 6
「Hiiiiih......!! D-Don't come over heeeeere!!」
Bullets were sprayed persistently.
But they had no effect whatsoever.
The guards who surrounded the monster were slaughtered one after another by its tentacles, and what looked to be gravitational wave attacks.
Ayame
「What do we do, Madam? This has changed our plans quite a bit.」
Ayame, who also hid in the shadows, asked the woman.
Masked Taimanin
「......Seeing as it's woken up, I suppose we have no choice but to deal with it by force.」
Ayame
「By force?」
Masked Taimanin
「Yes. We'll have to destroy it here, or it'll be too late. In which case――」
Masked Taimanin
「――Asuka!! It's your turn!!」
Koukawa Asuka
「Roger! Leave it to meeeee～～～～!」
Following a sparkling flash, a pink Taimanin suit appeared.
It was Taimanin Koukawa Asuka, who belonged to the “DSO”, and had been using optical camouflage to hide herself.
In case of a situation where it became necessary to destroy Ba Chou, the woman had been making Asuka, who was famed for her firepower, stand by on alert.
Ayame
「As I thought! I figured you came along, Asuka.」
Asuka
「Long time no see, Ayame-san! Sorry it's so sudden, but I'm gonna be the first to take that enemy on, okay～?!」
Asuka
「Killer Blow: Annihilation Missile!!!」
Doooooonnh!!!
Ba Chou
「AaAaaAaAAAHHHH?!!!!」
The miniature missiles that had been launched from Asuka's Android Arm landed direct hits on Ba Chou's body, but――
Asuka
「Ehh?! What is this thing?!」
Ba Chou
「AHHH...... AaaAaaAAAAaaAAAAHHHHHH!!!」
Ba Chou was alive and well.
Even though it had taken the missiles head-on and been blown apart, it promptly stood up again.
The flesh of its upper body had been heavily gouged out, yet it regenerated while they watched, as if turning back time.
Masked Taimanin
「This regeneration ability...... Black's power, huh?」
The masked woman clicked her tongue.
The astounding regenerative power of the King of Vampires had been inherited by the enhanced human produced from his cells.
Ba Chou
「AHHH...... AaAaAAaAHHHH!!!」
Having bellowed a murderous cry, Ba Chou approached the masked woman and Asuka.
And then――
Guard
「Intruders?! No prob. Dispose of 'em and Ba Chou together!!!」
Ayame
Guards had come running in as reinforcements.
Rifle-toting men encircled Ba Chou, Ayame and the others, in order to restrict their movements.
Ayame
「――Well, what do we do, Madam? It looks like the situation's gotten about ten times worse than planned.」
Masked Taimanin

「My, I wonder if ten is enough?
――Asuka! We'll go after Ba Chou. Ayame, you hold the rear!」
Asuka
「Roger!! That was just a warmup, before!」
Ayame
「All right, consider it done.」
Ba Chou
「AAAaaaAaAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!」
Guard
「Fire!! Fiiiire!!!」
A dangerous enhanced human ahead of them, and a shower of bullets raining down from behind――
Facing their respective enemies, the trio went to battle.
